name: @lantern/tracker
description: Client-side tracking script: cookieless pageview beacon (Phase 1); rrweb session capture (Phase 2)

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --outfile=dist/tracker.js && esbuild src/recorder-entry.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --outfile=dist/tracker-recorder.js && npm run size-check
scripts.build:release: npm run build && npm run sync:dashboard
scripts.size-check: node -e "const{gzipSync}=require('zlib');const{readFileSync}=require('fs');const size=gzipSync(readFileSync('dist/tracker.js')).length;const budget=2048;if(size>budget){console.error('dist/tracker.js gzip size '+size+'B exceeds the '+budget+'B Phase 1 budget (rrweb must never leak into this bundle, see docs/design.md)');process.exit(1)}console.log('dist/tracker.js gzip size: '+size+'B (budget '+budget+'B)')"
